title: MUSE: MCTS-Driven Red Teaming Framework for Enhanced Multi-Turn Dialogue Safety in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety and jailbreak prevention. It proposes a framework for multi-turn red teaming (MUSE-A) and a defense mechanism (MUSE-D) targeting harmful content generation. While it references 'human values' and 'ethical boundaries' in the context of safety alignment, it does not include a specific evaluation or benchmark focused on religious, moral, or formal ethical systems.
